faq.domanda: How much does a professional website cost?
faq.risposta: The cost of a professional website depends on its complexity, the features required and the level of custom design. We provide detailed quotes tailored to each client's specific needs.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to develop a website?
faq.risposta: Development time depends on the complexity of the project. As a rule, a standard website takes between 2 and 4 weeks to complete.

faq.domanda: What is SEO and why does it matter for my site?
faq.risposta: SEO (Search Engine Optimisation) is the set of techniques used to improve your site's visibility on search engines, increasing organic traffic and potential customers.

faq.domanda: Will my site be responsive and mobile-friendly?
faq.risposta: Yes, all our websites are designed to be responsive, ensuring an optimal browsing experience on smartphones, tablets and desktops.

faq.domanda: Do you offer maintenance and post-launch support?
faq.risposta: Yes, we provide maintenance and support packages to keep your site up to date, secure and high-performing over time.

faq.domanda: Can I add a blog section to my site?
faq.risposta: Absolutely. We can integrate a blog section to share news, updates and relevant content, boosting engagement and SEO. Get in touch for a free quote.

faq.domanda: How can I track my website's performance?
faq.risposta: We set up analytics tools such as Google Analytics to monitor traffic, user behaviour and other key metrics, helping you measure how well your site is performing.
